strengths: Snapshot guards stop explicitly even inside shell conditions.
Fallback requires verified, nonce-bound evidence of the backend's exact exit status.
Producer mismatches receive explicit diagnostics, and backend stderr remains visible.
summary: Reviewed all 286 membership paths and their committed diffs for failure propagation, diagnostics and fallback behavior. No reportable error-handling defects found. Runtime suites were not run under the read-only constraint.
